latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the community-group-buying marketing & promotion skill pack.

- Covers end-to-end skills for community group buying: activity planning, hot product development, coupon system, platform strategy comparison, and supporting tools.
- Includes detailed SOPs for hot item launches, coupon system design, major promotion planning, and emergency handling of overselling.
- Provides annual and weekly promotional calendars, and compares marketing strategies across major platforms (Meituan, Pinduoduo, Xingsheng, Taocaicai).
- Suitable for platform operations and marketing managers.
- All module boundaries are clearly defined and do not overlap with other aspects like supply chain, group leader operations, and customer acquisition.
